summary: XCF Global Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting termination of a Purchase Agreement with Helena Global Investment Opportunities I LTD, under which it could sell up to $50M of common stock at a formula-based price equal to the lowest intraday price over three trading days post-advance. Termination releases ~55M reserved shares, reducing potential dilution and market overhang, and may curb short-selling dynamics. The company retains flexibility to pursue other financing. No premiums, dates, or advisors are specified. This is a termination of an equity line, not a definitive deal; watch for alternative financing announcements.
